arxiv-2103-03630.title: Value distribution and uniqueness for q-difference of meromorphic functions Sharing Two Sets
arxiv-2103-03630.creator: Goutam Haldar
arxiv-2103-03630.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate the value distribution for linear q-difference polynomials of transcendental meromorphic functions of zero order which improves the results of Xu, Liu and Cao ( [ 26 ] ). We also investigate the uniqueness of zero order meromorphic function with its q-difference operator sharing two sets with finite weight.

arxiv-2111-10402.title: Influence Dynamics Among Narratives
arxiv-2111-10402.creator: Akshay Aravamudan, Xi Zhang, Jihye Song, Stephen M. Fiore, Georgios C. Anagnostopoulos
arxiv-2111-10402.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Akshay Aravamudan, Xi Zhang, Jihye Song, Stephen M. Fiore, Georgios C. Anagnostopoulos. It is widely understood that diffusion of and simultaneous interactions between narratives — defined here as persistent point-of-view messaging — significantly contributes to the shaping of political discourse and public opinion. In this work, we propose a methodology based on Multi-Variate Hawkes Processes and our newly-introduced Process Influence Measures for quantifying and assessing how such narratives influence (Granger-cause) each other.

arxiv-2201-00054.title: Generalized Hyperbolic Spaces Associated with Arbitrary Quadratic Forms
arxiv-2201-00054.creator: Shaul Zemel
arxiv-2201-00054.description: Abstract Introduction Clifford algebras were observed, over a century ago, to play a very important role in the theory of quadratic spaces. Their group of units contain two natural subgroups, the Clifford group acting on the quadratic space itself, and the paravector Clifford group, acting on the extension of the space by the scalars as an extended quadratic space.

arxiv-2211-16403.title: Bayesian Simultaneous Factorization and Prediction Using Multi-Omic Data

arxiv-2211-16403.description: Abstract Understanding of the pathophysiology of obstructive lung disease (OLD) is limited by available methods to examine the relationship between multi-omic molecular phenomena and clinical outcomes. Integrative factorization methods for multi-omic data can reveal latent patterns of variation describing important biological signal.

arxiv-2312-06471.creator: Giorgio Cignarale, Roman Kuznets
arxiv-2312-06471.description: Abstract Standard epistemic logic is concerned with describing agents’ epistemic attitudes given the current set of alternatives the agents consider possible. While distributed systems can (and often are) discussed without mentioning epistemics, it has been well established that epistemic phenomena lie at the heart of what agents, or processes, can and cannot do.

arxiv-2402-09412.title: Non-locally Reconstructed both Sides of Wormhole and its Non-Traversability
arxiv-2402-09412.creator: H. Hadi 1
arxiv-2402-09412.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by H. Hadi 1. The theoretical implications of a traversable wormhole between entangled black holes are significant in terms of non-locality and superluminal signaling. By utilizing the entangled states of two maximally entangled black holes, it becomes possible to construct a wormhole.

arxiv-2403-05325.title: Fine-tuning a Multiple Instance Learning Feature Extractor with Masked Context Modelling and Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2403-05325.creator: Juan I. Pisula, Katarzyna Bozek
arxiv-2403-05325.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Juan I. Pisula, Katarzyna Bozek. The first step in Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) algorithms for Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification consists of tiling the input image into smaller patches and computing their feature vectors produced by a pre-trained feature extractor model. Feature extractor models that were pre-trained with supervision on ImageNet have proven to transfer well to this domain, however, this pre-training task does not take into account that visual information in neighboring patches is highly correlated.

arxiv-2407-16798.title: Conformal limits for parabolic 𝖲𝖫 ⁡ ( n , ℂ ) {\mathsf{SL}}(n,{\mathbb{C}}) -Higgs bundles
arxiv-2407-16798.creator: Brian Collier, Laura Fredrickson, Richard Wentworth
arxiv-2407-16798.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Brian Collier, Laura Fredrickson, Richard Wentworth. In this paper we generalize the conformal limit correspondence between Higgs bundles and holomorphic connections to the parabolic setting. Under mild genericity assumptions on the parabolic weights, we prove that the conformal limit always exists and that it defines holomorphic sections of the space of parabolic λ \lambda -connections which preserve a natural stratification and foliate the moduli space.

arxiv-2409-07981.title: Economic impacts of a drastic gas supply shock and short-term mitigation strategies
arxiv-2409-07981.creator: Anton Pichler, Jan Hurt, Tobias Reisch, Johannes Stangl, Stefan Thurner
arxiv-2409-07981.description: Abstract The Russian invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022 entailed the threat of a drastic and sudden reduction of natural gas supply to the European Union. This paper presents a techno-economic analysis of the consequences of a sudden gas supply shock to Austria, one of the most dependent countries on imports of Russian gas.

arxiv-2506-03433.creator: Yifan Li, Xin Li, Tianqin Li, Wenbin He, Yu Kong, Liu Ren
arxiv-2506-03433.description: Abstract Vision foundation models (VFMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of downstream tasks. While several VFM adapters have shown promising results by leveraging the prior knowledge of VFMs, we identify two inefficiencies in these approaches. First, the interaction between convolutional neural network (CNN) and VFM backbone triggers early layer gradient backpropagation.

arxiv-2508-06159.title: Diagonalizing large-scale quantum many-body Hamiltonians using variational quantum circuit and tensor network
arxiv-2508-06159.creator: Peng-Fei Zhou, Shuang Qiao, An-Chun Ji, Shi-Ju Ran
arxiv-2508-06159.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Peng-Fei Zhou, Shuang Qiao, An-Chun Ji, Shi-Ju Ran. Exact diagonalization (ED) is an essential tool for exploring quantum many-body physics but is fundamentally limited by the exponentially-scaled computational complexity. Here, we propose tensor network variational diagonalization (TNVD), which encodes the full eigenenergy spectrum of a quantum many-body Hamiltonian into a matrix product state, and encodes the eigenstates as the evolutions of product states using variational quantum circuit (VQC).

arxiv-2511-02162.title: Text to Robotic Assembly of Multi Component Objects using 3D Generative AI and Vision Language Models
arxiv-2511-02162.creator: Alexander Htet Kyaw, Richa Gupta, Dhruv Shah, Anoop Sinha, Kory Mathewson, Stefanie Pender, Sachin Chitta, Yotto Koga, Faez Ahmed, Lawrence Sass, Randall Davis
arxiv-2511-02162.description: Abstract Advances in 3D generative AI have enabled the creation of physical objects from text prompts, but challenges remain in creating objects involving multiple component types. We present a pipeline that integrates 3D generative AI with vision-language models (VLMs) to enable the robotic assembly of multi-component objects from natural language.

In this study, we present the results from two series of tests with different strain ratios (R values).

To qualify, the Test must align with the excipients of the Reference product, while variations in flavor, color, and preservatives are allowed.

pmc-12804323.title: Breast Cancer Progression by the FGF/FGFR Axis: A Metabolic Perspective
pmc-12804323.creator: Jennifer E Tuokkola, Kathryn L Schwertfeger
pmc-12804323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Fibroblast growth factor receptors (FGFRs) are critical mediators of cellular signaling involved in development, tissue repair, and metabolic homeostasis. Dysregulated FGFR signaling is also a common feature in multiple cancer types, including breast cancer. In breast cancer, aberrant FGFR signaling can occur by amplification, mutation, isoform switching, or gene fusion and has emerged as a driver of tumor progression, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance. Beyond its canonical roles in proliferation and survival, recent evidence highlights FGFRs as key regulators of cancer cell metabolism.

pmc-13152267.title: Janus Kinase and Interleukin-6 Inhibitor-Induced Lipid Modulation and Its Association With Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events in Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Systematic Review of Clinical and Biomarker Evidence

pmc-13152267.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic systemic inflammatory disease associated with increased cardiovascular (CV) risk and alterations in lipid metabolism. Janus kinase inhibitors (JAKi) and interleukin-6 inhibitors (IL-6i) have offered effective control of disease activity; however, their impact on lipid profiles and subsequent CV outcomes has yet to be fully elucidated.
